rows.label: R01
rows.description: Cross-team scheduling remains sensitive because upstream schema changes and downstream reporting windows are tightly coupled, requiring coordinated cutoffs and fallback planning.

rows.label: R02
rows.description: Vendor onboarding checkpoints now include expanded security evidence reviews, increasing cycle time and shifting procurement readiness unless approvals are batched.

rows.label: R03
rows.description: Regional staffing maturity differs by market, so service consistency depends on interim training plans and structured shift handovers during peak windows.

rows.label: R04
rows.description: Data refresh cadence is still variable across environments, creating rerun overhead and reducing predictability for release validation.

rows.label: R05
rows.description: Decision log publication lag occasionally causes teams to execute against stale assumptions during cross-functional handoffs.

rows.label: R06
rows.description: Incident simulations show improving response speed, but escalation ownership boundaries still require clearer criteria for complex failure modes.

rows.label: R07
rows.description: Localization QA remains open for two regions, and unresolved terminology differences can reduce support accuracy after launch.

rows.label: R08
rows.description: Training completion is high, yet reinforcement is still needed for edge-case triage and handoff clarity.

rows.label: R09
rows.description: KPI definitions are aligned for core metrics, but partial data arrival handling still differs and can produce conflicting trend narratives.

rows.label: R10
rows.description: Governance gates are documented, though reviewer bandwidth contention can defer approvals by multiple days.

rows.label: R11
rows.description: Monitoring coverage is broad for freshness and null checks, but anomaly thresholds require tuning to avoid alert fatigue.

rows.label: R12
rows.description: Mitigation ownership is assigned across top risks, with the next step being conversion of narrative updates into leading indicators.
